## For a game pack (data/games/...)

- [ ] `npm run validate:packs` passes
- [ ] Route ids are new, never renumbered or reused (existing runs point at them)
- [ ] Routes and bosses are in the order you meet them
- [ ] German and English names are set (French, Spanish and Italian are optional)
- [ ] A new pack has `"dataStatus": "unverified"` until someone checks it against the game
- [ ] Sources are named below; data copied from another project keeps its license (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
